title: Insta360 GO Ultra Launches AI Voice Assistant, Integrates Qwen and Gemini
excerpt: Insta360 will launch an AI voice assistant feature for the GO Ultra thumb camera on August 7th. The feature uses different large model solutions based on region
content_html:
Insta360 will launch an AI voice assistant feature for the GO Ultra thumb camera on August 7th. The feature uses different large model solutions based on region: the Alibaba Qwen large model is integrated in mainland China, while Google Gemini is used in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and overseas regions. The translation results can be directly announced through the device's speaker.

According to the introduction, this AI assistant is based on Insta360's self-developed technology, integrating the multimodal capabilities of Qwen large model and the photo Q&A function of the Qwen App, using a terminal-cloud collaborative architecture. The terminal side is responsible for tasks such as voiceprint recognition and intent judgment, while the cloud completes complex processing such as intelligent Q&A, mode switching, and translation.

In terms of features, users can activate the assistant by saying "Hey Kira" or long-pressing the capture button while the device is off. It supports face-to-face translation, photo-based Q&A, and voice-based Q&A. Among these, face-to-face translation can be used in scenarios such as asking for directions, ordering food, and shopping; photo-based Q&A, after obtaining authorization, can identify content such as road signs, buildings, and dishes in the lens and provide analysis.

Liu Jingkang, founder of Insta360, stated that this feature may "redefine the thumb camera." This upgrade also shows that AI large models are accelerating into the consumer hardware field, driving smart cameras from being shooting tools to AI terminals with understanding and interaction capabilities.

content_html_zh:
Insta360将于8月7日为GO Ultra拇指相机推出AI语音助手功能。 该功能根据地区采用不同的大模型解决方案：中国大陆集成阿里巴巴Qwen大模型，而港澳台及海外地区使用谷歌Gemini。 翻译结果可以通过设备的扬声器直接宣布。

据介绍，这款AI助手基于Insta360自研技术，融合了Qwen大模型的多模态能力和Qwen App的拍照问答功能，采用端云协同架构。 终端侧负责声纹识别、意图判断等任务，云端完成智能问答、模式切换、翻译等复杂处理。

在功能方面，用户可以通过说“Hey Kira”或在设备关闭时长按拍摄按钮来激活助手。 支持面对面翻译、拍照问答、语音问答。 其中，面对面翻译可用于问路、点餐、购物等场景；基于照片的问答，在获得授权后，可以识别镜头中的路标、建筑物、菜肴等内容并提供分析。

Insta360创始人刘靖康表示，这一功能可能“重新定义拇指相机”。 此次升级也表明AI大模型正在加速进军消费硬件领域，推动智能相机从拍摄工具转变为具有理解和交互能力的AI终端。
